name: graph-engineering-loop
description: Bounded evidence-first engineering loops backed by persistent knowledge-graph memory.

interface.shortDescription: Run verified loops with graph memory.
interface.longDescription: Turns engineering work into a bounded hypothesis, implementation, verification, critique, and decision loop while preserving decisions and evidence in graph memory.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run a bounded evidence-first engineering loop for this task and retain only safe, source-backed decisions in graph memory.
